description.value: Euro Food & Deli is an Eastern European specialty deli offering imported products from Hungary, Romania, Russia, Ukraine, and other countries, alongside house-made items like perogies, cabbage rolls, and borscht. The Maple Ridge location is one of three Lower Mainland stores (also in Port Moody and Burnaby). It is a distinctive stop for cyclists looking for something beyond standard convenience fare in the Fraser Valley.
